proof_state.program_identity: exact compiled multi-input plan bytes and layer initialization identities; mutable layer state excluded
proof_state.registry_binding_current: the current registry still matches all compiled layer initialization identities
proof_state.declared_input_ports: shape declarations from the compiled MultiInputGraphPlan, without inspecting or binding a runtime tensor
proof_state.steps: the ordered compiled graph steps, with input slot shapes propagated only by supported static rules
proof_state.output_f32_payload_bytes: checked product of the projected rank-4 shape and four bytes per f32; null when shape is unknown or cannot fit u64

static_rules.elementwise_add_sub_mul: equal rank-4 input shapes; mismatch is incompatible
static_rules.batched_matmul: matching batch and channel axes and contracted dimension; output is [a0,a1,a2,b3]
static_rules.concat: matching non-concat axes and checked extent sum; output is the summed axis
static_rules.activation_except_glu_and_swiglu: output shape equals input shape; this does not validate runtime parameters
static_rules.shift_and_norm: output shape equals input shape; this does not validate runtime parameters
static_rules.feature_norm: input must be [B,F,1,1] with F > 0; output shape equals input shape
static_rules.other_operators: unknown; explanation continues with null output shapes until a later step can establish a shape

valid_transitions: compile an exact MultiInputGraphPlan against the initialized LayerRegistry
read explainPlan and inspect registry_binding_current and each step shape_status
bind the actual input bundle and call preflight for runtime input freshness
call run for Burn's final numerical and operator verdict
explicit_limits: A complete static shape projection proves only the supported shape transformations; it is not a claim that Burn execution succeeds.
An incompatible projection blocks only the shown static shape contract; no tensor is executed and no receipt is issued.
An unknown projection is not a rejection of the graph or its operator.
The projected output payload size excludes intermediate tensors, weights, allocator overhead, and backend storage.
Program identity excludes mutable state; a fresh runtime bundle and the current registry must be checked separately.
